title: Multi-Year Name Rate on Second-Key Orders
content:
**Rate card note — SSL/TLS Certificates: multi-year name rate on second-key orders.**

The extra names of a second-key order (a further subscription of the same product, common name and number of extra names as an active subscription the customer already holds, for another server that needs its own key) are priced at the multi-year name rate of the second-key term:

- for a **three-year** term, each name's yearly price is multiplied by the product's 3-year price per year divided by its 1-year price;
- for a **two-year** term, each name's yearly price is multiplied by the product's 2-year price per year divided by its 1-year price;
- for a **one-year** term, each name's yearly price stays at the product's price per added name per year.

The multiplier acts on the yearly price of each extra name of the second-key order.

**Certificate prices that set the multiplier (USD).**

| Product | 1-year price | 2-year price per year | 3-year price per year |
|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline DV Single Domain | 19.99 | 17.99 | 15.99 |
| Harborline DV Multi-Domain | 49.99 | 44.99 | 39.99 |
| Harborline DV Wildcard | 89.99 | 80.99 | 71.99 |
| Harborline OV Single Domain | 69.99 | 62.99 | 55.99 |
| Harborline OV Wildcard | 219.99 | 197.99 | 175.99 |
| Harborline EV Single Domain | 169.99 | 152.99 | 135.99 |
| Harborline EV Multi-Domain | 279.99 | 251.99 | 223.99 |

**Reading the rate.**

- A three-year second-key order on Harborline EV Multi-Domain multiplies each name's yearly price by 223.99 divided by 279.99.
- A two-year second-key order on Harborline DV Multi-Domain multiplies each name's yearly price by 44.99 divided by 49.99.
- A one-year second-key order on either product leaves each name's yearly price unchanged.

**Hypothetical illustration.** Suppose an extra name whose yearly price is USD 6.40 (an illustrative figure) on a three-year second-key order of a product whose 3-year price per year is 80 percent of its 1-year price: that name's yearly price becomes USD 5.12.
